{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse, loose fit, cropped length, #d65a5a (red), soft cotton with a subtle ribbed texture.
Pants, wide-leg cut, ankle length, #2c2a28 (charcoal), heavy-weight wool crepe with a fluid drape.
Leather loafers, rounded toe, flat sole, #9e403d (terracotta), smooth full-grain leather.
This outfit strikes the perfect balance for your first date in the park, honoring your wish for red while maintaining a polished yet effortless vibe suitable for autumn daylight. The loose blouse offers comfort for walking through the trees without feeling restricted, allowing you to relax during our coffee conversation. The charcoal pants ground the bright top elegantly, ensuring you look put-together without being overdressed for a casual outdoor setting."}
